title: A security baseline still uses a deprecated legacy template

report.title: {Items.Count} assigned security {Plural(Items.Count, 'baseline uses', 'baselines use')} a deprecated legacy template

messages.businessImpact: A baseline on a deprecated template receives none of Microsoft's newer recommendations and can no longer be edited, so the protection it enforces is fixed at an older idea of good.
messages.technicalDetail: Older security baselines were built on Intune's legacy templates, which Microsoft has replaced with Settings Catalog templates. A legacy baseline cannot be moved to the new format in place; it has to be recreated.
remediation: Create a baseline from the current version of the same product under Endpoint security, Security baselines, and compare its settings with the old one.
Move the assignment to the new baseline, confirm devices report it as applied, then delete the old one.
messages.cannotSee: Which devices the baseline reaches: a legacy baseline's assignments are not read, so this finding is weighed at the floor rather than by its reach. Its settings are not compared with Microsoft's defaults either. A template whose state Graph did not return leaves the baseline unjudged.
